Test fixtures from the CUE4Parse project (Apache-2.0,
https://github.com/FabianFG/CUE4Parse) - a synthetic UE 5.8 game used by its own
unit tests. Included for verifying DualForge's usmap reader/writer against the
real CUE4Parse format: IoStore paks (unversioned, uncompressed) + global chunk
+ the Zstandard and uncompressed usmap variants.
